game_version_note: The game build is TIGlobalValuesState.latestSaveVersion, which the fixtures leave out or set to synthetic strings.
provenance: Hand-authored synthetic structural derivatives of private user-provided Terra Invicta campaign saves inspected locally on the recorded capture date.
privacy_note: No original save is included. Names, identifiers, dates, and state values are synthetic; do not add player, account, path, councilor, habitat, or ship data from a real campaign.
licensing_note: These synthetic fixtures are repository-authored material under the repository MIT license. They do not grant rights to Terra Invicta saves, assets, or game data.

fixtures.version_assumption: Observed JSON envelope.
fixtures.purpose: Decode a complete valid Terra Invicta-shaped JSON document to a RawSave.

fixtures.version_assumption: Observed JSON envelope and observed field names.
fixtures.purpose: Normalize metadata, time, factions, nations, regions, and control points: control ownership (owned, unowned, unresolved nation), a missing field, an undocumented field, mixed army reference types, a federation referenced by a nation, an empty {} container, and an unknown state type.

fixtures.version_assumption: Observed JSON envelope and observed field names.
fixtures.purpose: Normalize councilors (ISO dates), missions (cross-domain targets), armies (both state types), fleets, ships, habs (one with a core module in slot 0 of its sector, one without sectors), and research: resolved, null, and unresolved references per domain (including a councilor located at a hab, a fleet whose parentFleet ID is absent, and a ship in an absent fleet), missing fields, a megafauna-only field, and a research singleton whose techProgress overlaps finishedTechsNames and has one element without a template name.

fixtures.version_assumption: Observed JSON envelope; unknown state types remain uninterpreted.

fixtures.version_assumption: Observed JSON envelope and observed field names.

Holds the entities and values that change, disappear (control point 12, councilor 101) or stay in a different order (nation regions) in the later snapshot; control points 9..12 exercise natural ID ordering.

fixtures.version_assumption: Observed JSON envelope and observed field names.
fixtures.purpose: Later snapshot of the same synthetic interval: scalar, reference (null to resolved, resolved to unresolved), membership, map-key and unknown-value changes; entities that appear (megafauna army 112, councilor 102, fleet 121); a reference list with a stale ID; a newly finished technology; a later date.

fixtures.version_assumption: Observed JSON envelope and observed field names.
fixtures.purpose: Earlier snapshot of a synthetic interval for the save-carried records layer; pair with records_after.json. Faction 15 carries every record field (ledger with allow-listed mission labels, destruction log, empty pair maps as {}, typed alien-site keys incl. an absent ID, counters, dated labels); faction 16 carries none (missing case); nation 20 has no executive change yet.

fixtures.version_assumption: Observed JSON envelope and observed field names.
fixtures.purpose: Later snapshot of the same synthetic interval: every log is a strict prefix extension (ledger, destruction log with an unresolved space body and a null destroyer, milestones), pair maps go from {} to one pair, keyed values change (faction hate, objective status, armies lost, boost account date), counters increment, a control point is lost, and nation 20 records a dated executive change by coup.

fixtures.version_assumption: Observed JSON envelope and observed field names.
fixtures.purpose: Earlier snapshot of a synthetic interval for the politics analyzers; pair with politics_after.json. Factions 15/16 with councilor and control-point rosters (faction 16 with an empty lostControlPoints record), nations 20..22 with regions, rivals, control points and an executive-change record on nation 20, control points 9..11, councilors 100..102 and a hab as a councilor location. Nations 20..22 carry empty claims and hostileClaims lists, and nation 20 a factionUnrestAttempts pair map with one attempt by faction 16.

fixtures.version_assumption: Observed JSON envelope and observed field names.
fixtures.purpose: Later snapshot of the same synthetic interval: a control point whose controller changes faction (with both rosters and a dated lostControlPoints entry) and one that becomes uncontrolled; a control point and a region that move to another nation; a capital change; a breakaway link; a reciprocal war entry and a one-sided rival removal; a re-dated executive change; a councilor that changes faction, status and detaining faction; a councilor that moves from a region to a hab (priorLocation set); a councilor whose faction becomes null; a nation control-point list with an unmirrored member; a faction councilor list with a stale ID. Nation 21 gains a claim on region 40 and nation 22 a hostile claim on region 42 (both held by nation 20); nation 20's factionUnrestAttempts count for faction 16 rises and one for faction 15 is added.

fixtures.version_assumption: Observed JSON envelope and observed field names.
fixtures.purpose: Third snapshot after politics_after.json for save-sequence tests: region 42 returns to nation 21 and control point 9 returns to faction 16 (with both nations' region lists and both factions' control-point rosters), so the same subjects change in two consecutive intervals. Claims, hostile claims and unrest attempts stay as in politics_after.json.

fixtures.version_assumption: Observed JSON envelope and observed field names.
fixtures.purpose: Earlier snapshot of a synthetic interval for the war and federation analyzers; pair with wars_after.json. Nations 20..25 with mirrored wars lists and federation references, war 90 (20 against 21), war 91 (22 against 23), both with start and last-fighting dates, and federation 80 with members 24 and 25.

fixtures.version_assumption: Observed JSON envelope and observed field names.
fixtures.purpose: Later snapshot of the same synthetic interval: war 91 is absent, war 92 (23 against 25) is present with a start date inside the interval, war 90 gains nation 22 on the attacking side and a later last-fighting date, federation 80 gains nation 20 and loses nation 25 (mirrored by their federation references), and nation 24 lists a wars entry no war explains. Federation 80 is renamed (displayName and federationName change together).

fixtures.version_assumption: Observed JSON envelope and observed field names.
fixtures.purpose: Earlier snapshot of a synthetic interval for the army, space and technology analyzers; pair with assets_after.json. Factions 15/16 with fleet and army rosters and a one-entry HabDestructionLog on faction 15, nations 20/21 and regions 40..42 with army lists, armies 110/111/113, fleets 120/121 with ships 130..132, habs 140/141 sharing sector 160 with core module 170, an orbit pair, a space body 50 with a moon 51 whose barycenter points at it, and a research singleton with two finished techs and one progress entry. Faction 15 carries shipDesigns (dataName, hullName) for every ship template; faction 16 an empty list.

fixtures.version_assumption: Observed JSON envelope and observed field names.
fixtures.purpose: Later snapshot of the same synthetic interval: an army that changes region (region and nation lists mirror it) and strength; an army that changes faction (faction lists mirror it), type and destroyed flag; an army absent from the save; a megafauna army that appears; a fleet that docks (hab list mirrors it), changes orbit, gains a ship and gets an unresolved parentFleet; a fleet that changes faction and enters combat; a fleet that appears docked; a ship whose refit date is set; a ship that moves between fleets; a ship absent and one present only here; a hab whose faction, tier and assault flag change with an unexplained docked fleet; a hab absent from the save; two added destruction-log entries (one with an unresolved space body and a null destroyer); a tech that finishes, one that appears finished, one progress-only, and a finished name removed. The ship designs are unchanged, so the hulls of the ship present only here and of the absent one both resolve.

fixtures.version_assumption: Observed JSON envelope and observed field names.
